zh: 报告的截止日期是本周五。
en: The {deadline} for the report is this Friday.

zh: 今天会议的议程上有什么？
en: What's on the {agenda} for today's meeting?

zh: 你能负责记今天的会议纪要吗？
en: Could you take the {minutes|notes} at today's meeting?

zh: 经理对我的演讲给了一些很有用的反馈。
en: My manager gave me some useful {feedback} on my presentation.

zh: 两个人离开团队后，我的工作量翻了一倍。
en: My {workload} has doubled since two people left the team.

zh: 我和同事们相处得很好。
en: I get on well with my {colleagues|coworkers|co-workers|workmates}.

zh: 我这周上夜班。
en: I'm on the night {shift} this week.

zh: 我们每个月底给客户开发票。
en: We send {invoices|bills} to our clients at the end of each month.

zh: 你签合同了吗？
en: Have you signed the {contract|agreement} yet?

zh: 她才工作一年就升职了。
en: She got a {promotion} after only one year.

zh: 请提供两位推荐人的联系方式。
en: Please include contact details for two {references|referees}.

zh: 我明天上午有个工作面试。
en: I have a job {interview} tomorrow morning.

zh: 他昨天递交了辞呈。
en: He handed in his {resignation|notice} yesterday.

zh: 我十二月要休两周年假。
en: I'm taking two weeks of annual {leave} in December.

zh: 你可以在人事系统里下载工资单。
en: You can download your {payslips} from the HR portal.

zh: 我上周加了十个小时的班。
en: I did ten hours of {overtime} last week.

zh: 我的年度绩效考核在下个月。
en: My annual performance {review|appraisal} is next month.

zh: 我们需要让所有利益相关方了解进展。
en: We need to keep all the {stakeholders} informed.

zh: 我们先定出这个季度最重要的三个优先事项吧。
en: Let's agree on our top three {priorities} for this quarter.

zh: 上个季度我们完成了所有销售指标。
en: We hit all our sales {targets|goals} last quarter.

zh: 我还得把明天演讲用的幻灯片做完。
en: I still need to finish the {slides} for tomorrow's presentation.

zh: 应用上线对团队来说是一个重要的里程碑。
en: Launching the app was a major {milestone} for the team.

zh: 新员工头三个月是试用期。
en: New staff are on {probation|trial} for the first three months.

zh: 他去年接受了自愿裁员。
en: He took voluntary {redundancy} last year.

zh: 支持团队有两个职位空缺。
en: We have two {vacancies|openings|positions} in the support team.

zh: 这个职位有一百多个申请人。
en: We had over a hundred {applicants|candidates} for the job.

zh: 休假前我会和新来的同事做工作交接。
en: I'll do a {handover} with the new guy before I go on holiday.

zh: 我每天单程通勤大约四十分钟。
en: My {commute} takes about forty minutes each way.

zh: 我们给客户发了一份新系统的提案。
en: We sent the client a {proposal} for the new system.

zh: 下单前你能让他们给个报价吗？
en: Can you get a {quote|quotation} from them before we order?

zh: 你在哪个部门工作？
en: Which {department} do you work in?

zh: 新员工第一周要参加两天的入职培训。
en: New staff do a two-day {induction|orientation} in their first week.

zh: 你在这份工作中的主要职责是什么？
en: What are your main {responsibilities|duties} in this job?

zh: 她明年要转到管理岗位。
en: She's moving into a management {role|position|job} next year.

zh: 如果你想离职，必须提前四周通知。
en: You have to give four weeks' {notice} if you want to leave.

zh: 我用电子表格记录这些数字。
en: I keep track of the numbers in a {spreadsheet}.

zh: 三月份的销售数字看起来很不错。
en: The sales {figures|numbers|results} for March look great.

zh: 这家公司在三个城市有办公室。
en: The company has {offices|branches} in three cities.

zh: 我们大部分IT员工都是通过招聘中介招来的。
en: We hire most of our IT staff through recruitment {agencies|firms}.

zh: 我老板这周不在。
en: My {boss|manager} is away this week.

zh: 周一有个新实习生要来。
en: We have a new {intern} starting on Monday.

zh: 我们请了两个合同工来帮忙完成这个项目。
en: We brought in two {contractors|freelancers|consultants} to help finish the project.

zh: 一个猎头在领英上联系我，说惠灵顿有个职位。
en: A {recruiter|headhunter} contacted me on LinkedIn about a job in Wellington.

zh: 我会在开会前一天给大家发个提醒。
en: I'll send everyone a {reminder} the day before the meeting.

zh: 请把你的简历发到这个邮箱。
en: Please send your {CV|resume} to this email address.

zh: 新的排班表每周四出来。
en: The new {roster|rota|schedule} comes out every Thursday.

zh: 免费停车是这份工作的福利之一。
en: Free parking is one of the {perks|benefits} of the job.

zh: 请在周五下午前提交工时表。
en: Please submit your {timesheets} by Friday afternoon.

zh: 我们换了供应商，因为原来那家太慢了。
en: We changed our {supplier|vendor|provider} because the old one was too slow.

zh: 我忘了在邮件里加附件。
en: I forgot to add the {attachment} to the email.
